decisions.reason: Although it was no longer visibly highlighted after 2019, transactional email is strategically central to the firm's cloud messaging direction and is more likely to be retained or folded into a broader platform than withdrawn.

As a narrow fax optimization feature in a firm moving toward broader multichannel digital workflows, it is the most exposed to portfolio cleanup and resource reallocation despite some remaining fit with legacy customer needs.

Threat protection still directly supports the firm's secure, compliant communications proposition, so even if the standalone branding has faded it is likely to remain as part of the security offering rather than be removed.
